question: Buddh International Circuit is located at:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Noida.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Buddh International Circuit** is located in **Greater Noida**, Uttar Pradesh, India.
 
• It is a world-class motor racing track, around 40 kilometers from New Delhi.
 
• The circuit was designed by renowned German architect **Hermann Tilke** and was the venue for the **Formula 1 Indian Grand Prix** from 2011 to 2013.
 
• The first Indian Grand Prix was held at the Buddh International Circuit on 30 October 2011
 
• The inaugural race was won by Red Bull Racing’s Sebastian Vettel.
